[ { "html_url": "https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/pull/118#discussion_r3940885603", "user": { "login": "cursor[bot]" }, "body": "### Join codes leak into PostHog events **Medium Severity** `sanitizeCaptureEvent` rewrites URL and path properties and drops `data-code`, but it never scrubs `$title`, `$prev_pageview_title`, or autocapture `$el_text` / `$elements` text. The player route title embeds the join code, and the host copy-link control still renders the raw join URL without `ph-no-capture` (`JoinCodeBadge` is also unprotected). Every `/game/$code` pageview and those clicks therefore send the live code as event properties, which this change set out to prevent.
